name: minecart-boat-painting-place
comment: WP-2.6. ItemMinecart.onItemUse, ItemBoat.onItemRightClick, ItemPainting.onItemUse. Stone y 60 with still water at x 2..4, z 0..2; rails at (-4, 61, 0..1), a powered rail at (-2, 61, 3), a snow layer at (0, 61, 0), a lone stone block at (6, 63, 5). The player (id 0) at (0.5, 61, -1.5), yaw -45, pitch 21, holds a minecart (hotbar 0), a chest minecart (1), two boats (2, 3) and 6 paintings (4). Minecarts: refused on stone; on a rail and on a powered rail an EntityMinecart of the item's type at the block's centre. Boats (use_item on a stone block, then sendUseItem): the eye ray stops on the water source (a boat on the water), then at yaw 0, pitch 40 it hits the snow layer (a boat one block lower, on the stone). Paintings on the four side faces of the lone block (direction 0, 2, 1, 3): only 1x1 motives fit, so the art the constructor draws from its (in the oracle unseeded) rand does not change the entity lines; a fifth on a taken face fails onValidSurface (true, nothing used up); the top face is refused.
